source:
@@U01995@@
The way she drags her feet you'd
think they were chained.
I must confess, she seems so very like
my dear good 格蕾琴.

@@U01997@@
Keep away!
That’s bad news for anyone!
It’s a lifeless apparition, a phantom.
Nothing good can come from such a meeting.
Its staring eyes can freeze a man’s blood
till he’s almost turned to stone.
You've heard the story of Medusa.

@@U01999@@
Yes, eyes of a dead girl
not closed by a loving hand.
This is the breast 格蕾琴 gave me,
the sweet body I enjoyed.

@@U02001@@
It’s sorcery, you gullible fool!
She appears to every man in the guise of his love.

@@U02003@@
What ecstasy!
What agony!
How can I tear myself from this vision!
How strange that lovely throat should be
adorned by one thin red thread
no wider than the blade of a knife.

@@U02005@@
Right you are! I see it, too.
She could just as well carry her head
tucked under her arm; after all,
珀耳修斯 cut it off for her.
Ah, but this hankering of yours for illusion!
translation:
@@U01995@@
她拖着脚步的样子你会
认为他们被锁住了。
我必须承认，她看起来非常像
我亲爱的好格蕾琴。

@@U01997@@
远离！
这对任何人来说都是坏消息！
这是一个没有生命的幻影，一个幻影。
这样的会议不会有什么好处。
它凝视的眼睛可以冻结人的血液
直到他几乎变成石头。
你一定听过美杜莎的故事。

@@U01999@@
是的，死去女孩的眼睛
没有被一只充满爱的手关闭。
这是格蕾琴给我的乳房，
我享受甜蜜的身体。

@@U02001@@
这是巫术，你这个容易受骗的傻瓜！
她以爱的幌子出现在每个男人面前。

@@U02003@@
多么狂喜啊！
多么痛苦啊！
我怎么能从这个异象中挣脱出来呢！
那可爱的喉咙该是多么奇怪啊
用一根细红线装饰
不比刀刃宽。

@@U02005@@
你是对的！我也看到了。
她也可以抬起头
夹在她的腋下；毕竟，
珀耳修斯替她斩断了。
啊，但是你对幻觉的渴望！
